defs.def: a narrow piece of wood, or a metal or plastic case, containing a black or coloured substance, used for drawing or writing 铅笔verb

ex.s: I decided that I wanted to learn as many words as I could and started marking every entry I looked up with a pencil to measure my progress.
ex.t: 那时我决心要尽可能多地学单词，并开始用铅笔标记每一个查过的词条，以此来衡量自己的进步。

ex.s: I continued to make these pencil marks for years, and when I went off to college, I packed that dictionary in my suitcase.
ex.t: 多年来我一直做着这些铅笔标记，离家上大学时，我把那本词典装进了行李箱。

ex.s: And after some work with a colored pencil I succeeded in making my first drawing.
ex.t: 在用彩色铅笔画了一会儿之后，我成功地完成了我的第一幅画。

ex.s: All the students have are pencils, rubbers, and paper.
ex.t: 所有学生拥有的只是铅笔、橡皮和纸。

ex.s: Picasso was born in1881,into a creative family in the Spanishcityof Malaga.His father wasa first word was"pencil".When he was young, his family would visit Madrid to see works by the old Spanish masters.
ex.t: 毕加索于1881年出生在西班牙马拉加市一个富有创造力的家庭。他说的第一个词是＂铅笔＂。小时候，他的家人会去马德里看西班牙古典大师的作品。

ex.s: When composing music at the piano, he would put one end of a pencil in his mouth and place the other end against the instrument so that he could feel the notes.
ex.t: 在钢琴前作曲时，他会把铅笔的一端放在嘴里，另一端靠在乐器上，这样他就能感受到音符的振动。

ex.s: With my new hand, I can move my individual fingers and hold on to small things like pens and pencils.
ex.t: 有了我的新假手，我可以活动我的各个手指，并握住像笔和铅笔这样的小东西。
